scale: Each source column is min-maxed inside that source, one benchmark at a time. 0 is the lowest model in that pull. 1 is the highest. A fraction sitting in a percent board is turned into points before the stretch. Repeated rows for one name are averaged first. Benchmarks in the same category are averaged, and the composite is the unweighted mean of the sources that had a number. Reliability is how many of the four categories that source had for the model. This is not a Night Grade night.
